note: Legend portraits, the shieldmaiden (Lead via Strategy, Dom 2026-09-27). One FLUX.1 [dev] text-to-image per rung, from the source text in src/legends.ts; never from a film, comic or game depiction. Final size 512x512. `style` is appended to every subject. The prompt is `framing` + `subject` + `style`.
framing: Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large and filling the upper half of the square frame, cropped at the chest, of
style: Dark painterly realism like an old oil painting, ancient brutal ceremonial tone, grounded proportions, muted palette of bronze, iron, bone, leather, stone and ash, a single low warm torchlight from one side leaving the rest in deep shadow, dark smoky near-black background, no saturated colours, no glowing effects, no text, no border, no frame.

legends.name: Shield Girl
legends.subject: a young farm girl turned warrior, braided fair hair, a freckled determined face, a battered round wooden shield with an iron boss, a simple wool dress and leather belt.

legends.name: Hervor
legends.subject: Hervor the shieldmaiden of the Hervarar saga, a fierce young woman in mail and a dark cloak, a burial mound behind her with a faint fire, a cursed sword in her hand.

legends.name: Camilla
legends.subject: Camilla the warrior queen of the Volsci, a swift young woman with hair bound back, a leopard skin over one shoulder, a light bronze helmet, a wild plain behind her.

legends.name: Lagertha
legends.subject: Lagertha the Danish shieldmaiden of Saxo, a tall woman with long loose hair over her shoulders, iron mail, a round painted shield, a battlefield of the old north behind her.

legends.name: Boudica
legends.subject: Boudica queen of the Iceni, a tall woman with a great mass of tawny hair to her hips, a heavy gold torc, a thick patterned cloak with a brooch, smoke of a burning city behind her.

legends.name: Tomyris
legends.subject: Tomyris queen of the Massagetae, a hard-faced steppe queen in a tall pointed felt cap with gold ornaments, a scale armour coat, a wide grassland behind her.

legends.name: Scathach
legends.subject: Scathach the warrior woman of Skye from the Ulster Cycle, a formidable older woman with grey-streaked red hair, a grey cloak, a dark fortress on a sea crag behind her.

legends.name: Penthesilea
legends.subject: Penthesilea the Amazon queen, a fierce woman in a crested bronze helmet and scale corselet, a crescent pelta shield, the walls of Troy behind her.

legends.name: Brynhildr
legends.subject: Brynhildr the valkyrie of the Volsunga saga, a proud tall woman in a gleaming iron helmet and mail, long fair hair, a ring of fire on a mountain behind her.

legends.name: Athena
legends.subject: Athena the Greek goddess of war and wisdom as in ancient statues, a tall crested Corinthian helmet pushed back, a stern calm face, the scaled aegis cloak on her shoulders, an owl behind her.
